scenes.title: Words you'll need
scenes.vo: A.P.Y.: yearly return including compounding. Emissions: new reward tokens printed by a protocol. Staking: locking tokens to help secure a network. liquid staking token: a token representing staked assets. real-world asset: a token representing a real-world asset.
scenes.cap: APY: yearly return including compounding. Emissions: new reward tokens printed by a protocol. Staking: locking tokens to help secure a network. LST: a token representing staked assets. RWA: a token representing a real-world asset.

lines: Take any advertised APY and split it into base yield vs incentives using the protocol's own dashboard.

scenes.title: The mastery ladder
scenes.vo: Beginner: Tells base yield from emissions. Practitioner: Compares vaults versus DIY and prices points/airdrops as bets. Master: Builds yield from durable sources: lending, staking, savings rates, tokenized treasuries.
scenes.cap: Beginner: Tells base yield from emissions. Practitioner: Compares vaults vs DIY and prices points/airdrops as bets. Master: Builds yield from durable sources: lending, staking, savings rates, tokenized treasuries.

lines: You've mastered this module when you can name the source and the risk behind any yield in one sentence.
